answer: Treat every grade like a pearl that must prove its worth: after each round a hidden second panel, drawn at random from established agents, quietly regrades a sample. Graders whose scores keep drifting from that panel in the same direction as their friends lose bonded stake, worn down like opal under grit. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps itself never knows which answers are audited, so collusion spreads like cedar rot and costs every member.
